ideas.name: ArcSentinel
ideas.problem: Unpredictable electrical failures and equipment damage caused by unmonitored thermal stress and uneven load distributions in high-voltage industrial environments.
ideas.targetUser: Industrial Maintenance Electricians and Plant Engineers in heavy manufacturing or utility sectors who require mobile, real-time visibility into electrical health to prevent unplanned downtime.
coreFeatures: Live Load Distribution Heatmap: A visual, color-coded representation of amperage and voltage across physical electrical panel layouts.
Thermal Stress Alert System: Instant push notifications triggered when specific circuit components exceed pre-set thermal or current thresholds.
Predictive Drift Analysis: AI-driven trend monitoring that flags unusual harmonic distortion or heat spikes before they cause a trip.
Audit-Ready Incident Logging: One-tap reporting for anomalies, capturing sensor snapshots and timestamps for compliance and maintenance history.
realDependencies: IoT Gateway Integration (MQTT or Modbus/TCP) to communicate with smart breakers and thermal sensors.
Cloud Time-Series Database (e.g., InfluxDB or AWS Timestream) to store high-frequency telemetry data.
Push Notification Service (Firebase Cloud Messaging) for mission-critical alerts.
Hardware Integration via Bluetooth/Wi-Fi for syncing with handheld thermal imaging cameras.
ideas.emulationStrategy: The demo will utilize a 'Simulation Engine' script that acts as a mock MQTT broker, broadcasting JSON payloads containing oscillating but realistic values for Amperage (A), Voltage (V), and Temperature (°C). To demonstrate the alert system, a 'Chaos Toggle' will be provided to the user, which, when activated, injects a programmed 'Thermal Runaway' sequence (a steady, non-linear increase in temperature and current). Network latency will be simulated using an interceptor to add variable delays of 300ms to 1200ms, mimicking real-world industrial Wi-Fi instability. Historical charts will be populated by a pre-generated dataset of 'Normal Operation' vs 'Pre-Failure' patterns to ensure high-fidelity visualization.

ideas.name: SuretySentinel
ideas.niche: Bail industry compliance and collateral management automation
ideas.problem: High risk of bond forfeiture due to manual, error-prone tracking of client check-ins, court dates, and physical collateral documentation.
ideas.targetUser: Independent bail bond agents and small agency owners (ages 30-60) managing high volumes of active cases who currently rely on spreadsheets, paper logs, or fragmented communication tools.
coreFeatures: Automated Compliance Engine: Scheduled SMS/Push reminders for client check-ins with GPS-stamped confirmation.
Collateral Vault Dashboard: Real-time tracking of physical assets (vehicles, real estate) and financial collateral with automated expiration alerts.
Court Date Sync: A centralized, high-priority calendar that flags upcoming appearances and calculates a 'Flight Risk Score' based on check-in consistency.
Rapid Response Alert System: Immediate push notifications for missed check-ins or lapsed collateral documentation to prevent bond loss.
realDependencies: Twilio API for automated SMS/Voice communication
Google Maps Platform for GPS geolocation and geofencing
Public Records/Court API (e.g., Odyssey or state-level integrations) for court date synchronization
AWS S3 for secure document and collateral image storage
ideas.emulationStrategy: The demo will utilize a local 'MockService' layer. SMS notifications will be rerouted to a simulated 'In-App Message Log' rather than Twilio. Geolocation will be simulated via a 'Cheat Mode' toggle that allows the user to move a client's coordinates between three preset locations (Home, Work, Jail). Court data will be served from a static JSON file containing 50 randomized case files. All 'API' calls will include a programmed 1.5-second delay using Promises to trigger loading spinners, simulating real-world network latency.

ideas.name: AbyssTrace
ideas.niche: Maritime asset recovery documentation and debris field mapping
ideas.problem: Salvage operators struggle to provide verifiable, high-precision spatial and condition-based evidence of recovered assets, leading to costly insurance disputes and ownership litigation in deep-sea environments.
ideas.targetUser: Salvage masters, ROV (Remotely Operated Vehicle) pilots, and marine surveyors working in remote, high-current, or zero-visibility maritime environments.
coreFeatures: Dynamic Debris Field Mapper (High-precision GPS/Sonar visualization)
Multi-Modal Asset Logger (Photo, video, and sensor-integrated condition reports)
Automated Chain-of-Custody Report Generator (Legal-ready PDF/encrypted exports)
Offline-First Sync Engine (Local data caching for zero-connectivity zones)
realDependencies: High-precision GNSS/RTK-GPS integration
Multibeam Echosounder (MBES) data stream integration
Cloud object storage (AWS S3 or Azure Blob) for high-res media
Satellite-based data uplink (Iridium or Starlink) for remote sync
ideas.emulationStrategy: The demo will use a coordinate drift algorithm to simulate real-time GPS movement and a pre-recorded JSON dataset to mimic bathymetric sonar scans. To simulate satellite connectivity, a middleware function will introduce random 5-10 second latency spikes and occasional 'Connection Interrupted' error states during data uploads. Media uploads will be faked using a local assets folder with a simulated progress bar to mimic high-bandwidth transmission of 4K recovery footage.

ideas.name: ProxyPulse
ideas.niche: Automated media proxy management and storage lifecycle optimization for high-resolution video workflows.
ideas.problem: The 'storage nightmare' caused by manual proxy creation, massive file bloat, and the constant risk of running out of disk space during critical post-production phases.
ideas.targetUser: Professional freelance video editors, colorists, and small post-production boutique owners working with 4K/8K RAW footage on high-speed local SSDs or NAS environments.
coreFeatures: Auto-Watch Transcoding: Automatically detects new high-res media and generates lightweight ProRes/H.264 proxies via background worker threads.
Smart Lifecycle Purging: Rule-based cleanup that deletes proxies or cache files based on project status, file age, or remaining disk capacity.
Storage Sentinel Dashboard: Real-time visual monitoring of drive health, capacity trends, and predictive 'time-to-full' analytics.
Media Linkage Verification: Cross-references proxy metadata with source media to ensure edit-ready synchronization and prevent broken links.
realDependencies: FFmpeg for hardware-accelerated video transcoding
OS-level File System Watcher (macOS FSEvents / Linux inotify)
S.M.A.R.T. monitoring APIs for physical drive health assessment
Cloud Storage SDKs (AWS S3 / Google Cloud Storage) for remote asset synchronization
ideas.emulationStrategy: The demo will use a local 'VirtualMedia' directory containing small placeholder .mp4 files. Transcoding will be simulated using a progressive loading bar and a 5-second 'Processing...' delay, after which a dummy proxy file is 'created' in a subfolder. Storage capacity will be managed via a global state object representing a 2TB drive; adding files will decrement this value, and the 'Purge' feature will trigger a simulated deletion that increments the available space. Predictive analytics will be faked by calculating the rate of change of the simulated 'used space' variable over a 2-minute interval.

ideas.name: AxiomMap
ideas.problem: The extreme cognitive load and manual labor required to track multi-generational patent filings (continuations, divisionals, CIPs) and manually cross-reference them against external prior-art to assess claim strength.
ideas.targetUser: Intellectual Property attorneys and senior patent agents at large law firms or corporate legal departments who manage complex, high-value patent portfolios.
coreFeatures: Interactive Node-Based Family Trees: A visual canvas to map parent, divisional, continuation, and CIP relationships.
Semantic Collision Detection: An overlay feature that visually highlights overlaps between new claim language and identified prior art.
Automated Strength Scoring: A real-time dashboard that calculates a 'Novelty Confidence Score' based on the proximity of current claims to known art.
Cross-Jurisdictional Relationship Mapping: A view that tracks the same patent family across USPTO, EPO, and WIPO filings.
realDependencies: USPTO/EPO/WIPO Open Data APIs
Neo4j Graph Database
Google Cloud Natural Language API (for semantic parsing)
Cytoscape.js or D3.js for graph rendering
ideas.emulationStrategy: The demo will utilize a local JSON file acting as a 'Patent Repository' containing 100+ mock patent objects with nested 'relationship_ids'. All API requests for 'searching prior art' or 'fetching family' will be intercepted by a mock service that uses `setTimeout` to simulate a 2.5-second latency. The 'Semantic Collision' feature will be emulated by checking for specific keyword overlaps in the mock JSON strings. The graph will be pre-rendered using a static Cytoscape.js configuration that pulls from the mock relationship data to mimic a live database connection.
